charts.title: TOI-1694 b: orbits around TOI-1694
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1694's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1694 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mancini et al. 2026 (2026A&A...712A.147M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANCINI_ET_AL_2026): P 3.7701389 d

charts.title: TOI-1694 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1694 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (19, 20) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 396740648, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
